-- Loans and Grants (See Appendix A for explanation of Housing Improvement Program)
Rehabilitation services and Sec. 312 loans will be made available. The Campus CNRA is an area primarily of multiple structures.
-- John XXIII Senior Center
This project would provide $53,000 for rehabilitation of existing building areas being used for John XXIII Senior Center. A majo. purpose of this project is the removal of architectural barriers which restrict the mobility and accessibility of elderly and handicapped persons using the facility.
Gardner CNRA:
This program is based on an expanded Gardner target area. (Refer to Figure #6)
N: Highway 280
E: Guadalupe Freeway right-of-way
S: Willow Street between Guadalupe r/w and Bird Avenue; Fuller Avenue (back lot line of south side) between Bird Avenue and Los Gatos Creek
W: Bird Avenue between Willow Street and Fuller Avenue; Los Gatos Creek between Fuller and Highway 280
--Loans and Grants
Loans and grants will be available only in the existing area in the 4th year. This assistance will also be available in the expanded area in the 5th and 6th years. Funds will provide loans and grants for an estimated 103 houses. After the 6th year, another 257 substandard houses would remain in this area.
--Street Improvements
Street Improvements in the expanded area are proposed to begin in the 4th year. The improvements will include street resurfacing/reconstruction, curbs, gutters, sidewalks and lights, sanitary sewers, and storm drains, as needed, for the following streets:
4th Year
Delmas Avenue - Jerome to Willow Hull Avenue - Bird to east end
5th Year
Prevost Street - Jerome to Atlanta
